text:
Priya: Heads-up: Nimbus just updated their AWS Marketplace SKU for the joint SI demo next week. Our reservation `nb-resv-442` no longer resolves. We need 10x H100-equivalent capacity in us-east-1 for a 72h stress run (Mon 09:00 -> Thu 09:00 UTC). Can procurement confirm availability and any lead-time changes?

capacity-bot: Marketplace sync error: SKU_MISMATCH for reservation nb-resv-442
```
status: FAILED
reservation: nb-resv-442
sku_old: NIM-H100-v1
sku_new: NIM-H100-pro
error: UNMAPPED_ALIAS
```

Raj: Looking. Vendor sent a notice: production reclassification; lead-time jumped 3 -> 14 days for reserved SKUs. We do have 4x H100 equivalents in our Dedicated pool in us-east-1, and 6x available in partner-managed hosters (requires purchase). If we bid for partner hold, cost +30% and non-refundable.

Theo: Is cross-region an option? us-west-2 has spare capacity but p99 > us-east by ~25ms. For the demo latency-sensitive path that's borderline. We can do a hybrid: route training traffic to us-west, inference to us-east if you only need inference throughput. But that needs routing + model split changes in Console.

Elena: Customer cares about demo fidelity for the press preview. They prefer no noticeable latency regressions. Could we instead scale the demo down to 8 devices now and then spin the full 10 when hardware arrives? Partner expects marketing collateral next Tue.

Raj: Two procurement paths: 1) expedite from vendor (14d ETA, but we can request a 7d partial ship for an extra fee), 2) buy spot/partner-hosted capacity for the 72h window. Option 2 is cheapest/time-safe but requires contract sign-off and marketplace delegation. Which risk do we accept?

Priya: We need a recommendation within 60m. Marketing already locked the press embargo. If we go spot, legal needs to sign the short-term SOW.

marketplace-integration-bot: Reservation nb-resv-442 now in state: PENDING_ALIAS_MAP. Attempting auto-resolve...

Theo: Quick proposal: Use 6 Dedicated + 4 partner-hosted for the window. Actions: (a) Raj requests partner hold + SOW for 4 nodes (b) I create route split in Console to direct demo workloads across the two pools with consistent model endpoints (c) Elena prepare scaled-down collateral for 8-node fallback. This avoids cross-region latency issues.

Raj: Initiated partner hold request (PO-9812) and sent draft SOW to legal. Vendor quoted +35% for emergency hold. ETA confirmation in ~45m.

Elena: I'll prepare the 8-node fallback slides and a short note for the PR team. If vendor confirms partial ship we go full 10.

capacity-bot: Partner hold request PO-9812 acknowledged by Nimbus portal. Hold expires in 48h unless PO funded.

Priya: Decision: proceed with Theo's hybrid plan. Raj please confirm funding ASAP. Elena please prep both the full and 8-node deck. I'll update Nimbus and the SI PM.

Raj: Funding approved for emergency hold. Vendor accepted PO-9812; partial ship ETA 6 days. I've also locked partner-hosted capacity for Thu-Fri window as fallback.

marketplace-integration-bot: SKU alias map updated: NIM-H100-pro -> internal-alias `nim-h100-pro-2026`. Reservation nb-resv-442 resolved.

Priya: Thanks. Final action list:
- Raj: confirm payment + SOW (done)
- Theo: implement route-split and canary to ensure model consistency across Dedicated + partner-hosted pools (window Mon 09:00 -> Thu 09:00 UTC)
- Elena: prepare two demo decks (8 and 10 node) and PR note for embargo
- capacity-bot: monitor reservation and alert if alias remap flips

Theo: Will push route split and canary by EOD and tag @oncall-eng for alerts.

Priya: Great work team. If legal flags any SOW changes ping me. We'll reconvene in 30m if vendor response changes. :rocket:
